changelog: v0.0.2: Organized live runtime and native cheats into independently toggleable categories with per-category master switches.

Enable_Flight.label: Master Switch: Movement & Flight
Enable_Flight.description: Enables or disables all live movement, creative hover flight, and jump height cheats in this category.

creativeHover.label: Creative Mode Hovering / Flight (Personal & Native)
creativeHover.description: Allows floating stationary in mid-air and flying vertically without falling (R to ascend, F to descend, or Ctrl+H to toggle).

hoverSpeed.label: Hover Speed Multiplier %
hoverSpeed.description: Vertical ascent and descent speed while creative hovering (100% = normal, up to 500%).

jumpHeightMultiplier.label: Live Jump Height Multiplier %
jumpHeightMultiplier.description: Multiplies vertical jump launch height in real time (100% = normal, up to 500%).

Enable_GodMode.label: Master Switch: God Mode & Survival
Enable_GodMode.description: Enables or disables God Mode invulnerability, infinite consumables, and Shroud timer freeze in this category.

infiniteHealth.label: Infinite Health / God Mode (Personal)
infiniteHealth.description: Boosts health regeneration and zeroes incoming enemy/boss damage factors so you become immune to lethal damage.

infiniteConsumables.label: Infinite Consumables (Native)
infiniteConsumables.description: Potions, food, bandages, and flasks are not consumed upon use.

infiniteShroud.label: Freeze Shroud Timer / Shroud God Mode (Native)
infiniteShroud.description: Bypasses engine shroud fog checks. Shroud timer is locked and will never tick down or kill you in the Shroud/Miasma.

Enable_Combat.label: Master Switch: Combat, Crits & Arrows
Enable_Combat.description: Enables or disables One-Hit Kill, critical strike modifiers, live damage multipliers, and infinite arrows in this category.

oneHitKill.label: One-Hit Kill / Infinite Damage (Personal)
oneHitKill.description: Deals lethal damage on any enemy or boss hit, instantly defeating them.

critChance.label: Critical Hit Chance % (Personal)
critChance.description: Additional critical hit chance percentage (0% to 100% max).

critDamageMultiplier.label: Critical Damage % (Personal)
critDamageMultiplier.description: Multiplier for critical strike damage (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

meleeDamageMultiplier.label: Melee Damage % (Personal)
meleeDamageMultiplier.description: Live attribute multiplier for melee weapon attacks (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

rangedDamageMultiplier.label: Ranged Damage % (Personal)
rangedDamageMultiplier.description: Live attribute multiplier for bows and thrown weapons (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

magicDamageMultiplier.label: Magic Damage % (Personal)
magicDamageMultiplier.description: Live attribute multiplier for staves, wands, and spells (100% = default, up to 2000% max).

infiniteArrows.label: Infinite Arrows & Quiver (Native)
infiniteArrows.description: Bypasses arrow consumption when shooting bows. Arrows in quiver never decrease.

Enable_CraftingRules.label: Master Switch: Free Building & Reskill
Enable_CraftingRules.description: Enables or disables free Construction Hammer block placement and zero-cost skill resets in this category.

freeCrafting.label: Free Building (Construction Hammer) & Perks (Native)
freeCrafting.description: Allows placing building blocks with the construction hammer and learning/upgrading perks without material checks (native memory bypass). For recipe/prop/altar crafting tweaks, see sf-cheatmenu-assets.

freeReskill.label: Free Reskill / Skill Reset (Zero Rune Costs)
freeReskill.description: Allows resetting skills at the Flame Altar with zero Rune costs.

Enable_WorldRules.label: Master Switch: World AI, XP & Production
Enable_WorldRules.description: Enables or disables enemy pacification, perception range, XP, drop yield, and workstation/plant speed overrides in this category.

dumbEnemies.label: Pacify World Enemies (Server/Host AI)
dumbEnemies.description: Enemies will not initiate attacks and are completely pacified.

enemyPerceptionMultiplier.label: Enemy Perception Range % (World/Server)
enemyPerceptionMultiplier.description: Detection and sight range of enemies (100% = normal, 0% = completely blind).

xpMultiplier.label: Experience (XP) Multiplier (World/Server)
xpMultiplier.description: Multiplies XP earned from combat, exploration, quests, and mining (1x = default, up to 100x).

itemAmountMultiplier.label: Resource Drop & Yield Multiplier (World/Server)
itemAmountMultiplier.description: Multiplies world resource drop factor in GameSettings (1x to 100x). For granular item/loot table multipliers, see Loot Drop Multipliers in sf-cheatmenu-assets.

productionSpeedMultiplier.label: Production Station Speed (World/Server)
productionSpeedMultiplier.description: Speed multiplier for furnaces, kilns, drying racks, and workbenches (1x to 50x).

plantGrowthMultiplier.label: Plant & Crop Growth Speed (World/Server)
plantGrowthMultiplier.description: Speed multiplier for seedlings, farm plots, and tree growth (1x to 50x).

groups.label: Movement & Flight
groups.description: Creative hovering, vertical flight controls, and live jump height scaling.

groups.label: God Mode & Survival
groups.description: Invulnerability (God Mode), infinite consumables, and Shroud fog timer freeze.

groups.label: Combat, Crits & Arrows
groups.description: Instant one-hit kill, critical strike multipliers, live damage amplification, and infinite arrows.

groups.label: Free Building & Reskill
groups.description: Free Construction Hammer block placement and zero-cost skill resets.

groups.label: World AI, XP & Production
groups.description: Passive enemy AI, perception range, XP/drop factors, and accelerated workstation production / plant growth.
